title: MetaSieve: Faster Relational Deep Learning through SQL-Based Metapath Selection
abstract: arXiv:2608.25903v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Relational Deep Learning (RDL) is an effective approach to machine learning over multi-table relational databases. In RDL, a database is modeled as a graph in which each row is a node and each foreign-key relation is an edge, and a graph neural network (GNN) is trained on this graph. Training a GNN requires sampling a subgraph around every seed node in the training set, and the cost of training is largely determined by the size of these subgraphs. This paper aims to reduce subgraph size by leveraging the join and aggregation capabilities of relational database systems. We observe that sampled subgraphs are obtained by following metapaths composed of foreign-key links, and that many of these metapaths can be pruned without loss of accuracy. translated_title: MetaSieve：通过基于SQL的元路径选择加速关系型深度学习
translated_abstract: 关系型深度学习（RDL）是对多表关系数据库进行机器学习的一种有效方法。在RDL中，数据库被建模为一个图，其中每一行是一个节点，每个外键关系是一条边，并在此图上训练图神经网络（GNN）。训练GNN需要在训练集中每个种子节点周围采样子图，训练成本主要由这些子图的大小决定。本文旨在通过利用关系数据库系统的连接和聚合能力来减小子图大小。我们观察到，采样得到的子图是通过跟随由外键链接组成的元路径获得的，并且许多这样的元路径可以在不损失准确性的情况下被剪枝。我们提出了MetaSieve，一个元路径选择层，用于确定保留哪些元路径以及剪枝哪些元路径。对于每个候选元路径扩展，MetaSieve通过SQL连接和聚合计算统计信息。
tldr: 本文提出MetaSieve，利用SQL连接和聚合能力，通过智能剪枝元路径来减小GNN训练子图大小，从而加速关系型深度学习，同时保持模型准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MetaSieve, which leverages SQL join and aggregation capabilities to intelligently prune metapaths, reducing GNN training subgraph sizes to accelerate relational deep learning while maintaining model accuracy.
